title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Midsalip in the Province of Zamboanga del Sur
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Midsalip in the Province of Zamboanga del Sur

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4871_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Barrios Midsalip, Guma, Bakahan, Guinabot, Kamaron, Lumpanid, Lumangoy, Dumalinao, Boloran, Sawa, Sominot, Bolobohan, Balonai, Timbaboy, Ganipay, Matalang, Sigapod, Duilic, Pawan, Dakayakan and Pisompongan, all of the Municipality of Ramon Magsaysay, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, and Barrios Pili, Cabaloran, Ecuan, Golictop, Guitalos and Licoro-an, all of the municipality of Dumingag, same province, are hereby separated from the said municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality, to be known as the Municipality of Midsalip, Province of Zamboanga del Sur. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of Barrio Midsalip.
The municipality shall be bounded as follows: "Beginning from point 1, intersection of latitude 7° 58’ and longitude 123° 23’; thence due west until it intersects longitude 123° 10’ called point 2; thence due north following partly the provincial boundary between Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur until it intersects latitude 8° 06’ called point 3; thence due east until intersects latitude 123° 23’ called point 4; thence due south back to point 1, point of beginning."
The first mayor, vice-mayor and councilors of the municipality shall be elected in the next general elections for local officials and shall have qualified.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 8, 1967.
